name: Rockhampton
water_basis: Fitzroy Barrage plus Rookwood Weir (74 GL, completed Nov 2023); council-stated supply-failure risk ~1 in 108 years
land_basis: Gracemere Industrial Area between Gracemere and Stanwell (high-impact industry permitted); total area not published

name: Gladstone
network_note: Calliope River 275 kV voltage-only Thevenin screen (Larcom Creek 275 kV reported as an alternative)
water_basis: Awoonga Dam allocation (78 GL/yr) fully committed and ~43-46% full in 2025; Fitzroy to Gladstone Pipeline adds up to 30 GL/yr from 2026
land_basis: Gladstone State Development Area, 26,934 ha of industrial land next to Calliope River and Larcom Creek

name: Livingstone (Yeppoon)
network_note: Connection point not confirmed - screened against nearest major 275 kV node (Bouldercombe); verify
water_basis: Capricorn Coast supply arrangement not confirmed in public sources (assumed linked to the Fitzroy system)
land_basis: Coastal residential/tourism area; no strategic industrial area identified

name: Karratha
network_note: Reduced 132 kV KRT-BUL-PCK ring firm N-1 (assumed impedance and source strength)
water_basis: West Pilbara Water Supply Scheme under major pressure (Harding Dam at record low, reduced aquifer recharge); Dampier desalination 8 GL/yr from 2027
land_basis: Maitland Strategic Industrial Area, 2,500 ha, 24 km west of Karratha

name: Port Hedland
network_note: Wedgefield 22 kV distribution upper bound; published 66 kV N-1 utilisation is 75-100% on Port Hedland elements
water_basis: Supply constrained; Water Corporation forecasts an extra 7.5 GL/yr needed; new desalination unlikely before 2030
land_basis: Boodarie Strategic Industrial Area, 4,000 ha, 4 km west of South Hedland
